image_description: A large, mature common iguana (Iguana iguana) resting on the ground amidst leaf litter and foliage. The iguana has a robust body with greyish-green coloration and distinct orange/reddish hues on its dorsal crest and limbs. It features a prominent serrated dorsal crest running from the neck to the tail, a large subtympanic shield, and muscular limbs. The head is turned slightly towards the viewer, showing a large eye and textured scales.
